FARMING_BOOK_PAGE_1_TEXT:
To start your farm, you will need a Land Pack. You can get one at the Composter or buy it from the Flower Shop.

With the Farm Plot in hand, you can place it in any free area on the ground, with space to walk around it.

With the plot positioned, select a Seed from your toolbar and click on the plot to plant. The rest is up to nature!
FARMING_BOOK_PAGE_2_TEXT:
Plants grow over time, even if you are out exploring. Time waits for no farmer!

When the plant is ready, approach and interact to harvest. Some plants, like Tomatoes and Corn, will keep producing after the first harvest!

After the final harvest, the plant may wither. Use any tool to clear the plot. Warning: hitting a healthy plant twice with a tool will also destroy it!
ITEM_LYLA_DIARY_DESC: The personal diary of Lyla Quinn, a young adventurer who recently moved to Bloomrise. Its pages are filled with thoughts, experiences, and discoveries about life in the village and her interactions with the local residents.
LYLA_DIARY_COVER_TEXT:
Do not read! (Unless you promise to give it back!)
— Lyla Quinn
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_1_TEXT: First day in Bloomrise! I was expecting a place with a bit more asphalt, but the people are nice, at least. My heels weren't as thrilled... got covered in mud….
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_2_TEXT: Lupi showed up with a mysterious seed and said a "singing-flower" would grow. I planted it… so far, it's just a shy little sprout. But I'm talking to it every day—flowers like compliments, right?
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_3_TEXT: Jaden and that square hair of his are on a mission: to test how many decibels the village can handle. Result: we all survived, but a few frogs seem to have fled the bar
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_4_TEXT: Milo is the most elegant toucan I've ever seen. I spent about ten minutes complimenting his feathers. He just blinked and left. I interpreted that as thank you.
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_5_TEXT: Victor is such a stickler, I think he proofreads his conversations before speaking. But he lent me a book—wearing gloves! Said it was to avoid leaving marks. I love it. I'm returning it with glitter.
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_6_TEXT: Wade brought me a piece of wood to practice hammering nails. I explained that my nails weren't made for this kind of adventure. He laughed loudly, taught me anyway… and I almost got it…. Almost.
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_7_TEXT: Selene served me tea with edible glitter (yes, it really sparkles!). Marcus said it was a new experiment. It was so sweet I almost danced on the bar counter!
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_8_TEXT: I really like Rayy—she has this brave and slightly clumsy way about her that's impossible not to admire. But honestly… a sparkly dress instead of those overalls would do wonders. Just a stylish suggestion.
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_9_TEXT: Max spends all day telling battle stories. I bet if a goblin actually showed up, he'd run away and then write a book about it. Still, can't deny he knows how to entertain the village.
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_10_TEXT: Darius is so skilled he could probably forge a dress as sparkly as mine. But I prefer to leave the clothing work to me… and just the swords to him.
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_11_TEXT: Minelli is so organized, sometimes it feels like he created the whole village. Sometimes, I get the feeling he decides what happens. If that's true, I hope he's reading this: I want more sunny days and new shoes.
LYLA_DIARY_PAGE_12_TEXT: Sometimes, Bloomrise feels like a living painting—and I love being the little red dot with pigtails in the middle of all this green. I think I like it here more than I imagined…

Remember to manage your inventory and store extra resources in chests or fridges for future use.

ITEM_BOOK_MAX_DESC: The legendary adventures of Max Rook, the most famous adventurer who ever lived. From his epic battles against fearsome monsters, this book narrates the life of a man who became a living legend.
BOOK_MAX_1_TITLE: Rook's Chronicles: The End of the Road
BOOK_MAX_1_TEXT: Long before any seeds were planted in the clearing, long before the tavern's first beam was erected, Max Rook's name was a currency in itself. Back then, he wasn't just Max. He was "The Big Max", "Rook the Relentless", "The Blade of Thunder". Songs were sung about him in taverns he would never visit, detailing deeds that, to his annoyance, were almost always true.
BOOK_MAX_2_TEXT:
He was the adventurer par excellence. His life was steel, the dust of the road, and the stench of damp crypts. His sword, The Thunder Blade, hummed faintly even in its scabbard, always eager for the next conflict.

And there was no shortage of conflicts.
BOOK_MAX_3_TEXT: He was the one who, alone, faced the Great Murkmire Slime. The refugees he saved swore the creature was the size of two houses. Max never corrected them. He just wiped the goo off his boot and moved on, perfecting his infamous "Heron's Lunge" — a quick strike, straight to the core, which he developed after noticing that brute force just made him slip.
BOOK_MAX_4_TEXT: He was also the one who, according to legend, found himself surrounded by a band of fifty (or perhaps sixty, the number grew each year) Goblins in the Ancient Forest. Unarmed, his sword stuck in a zombie thirty paces away, he just picked up a dry stick from the ground. Now the fight is fair, he reportedly said. The stories don't usually detail what happened next, only that the Goblins developed a deep fear of twigs for the rest of their short lives.
BOOK_MAX_5_TEXT: But glory is a loud companion. The jingle of coins, the applause in taverns, the constant cry of Danger!... it all became a single, dull noise.
BOOK_MAX_6_TEXT: The turning point, he would recall later, was in the Forgotten Crypt. He was facing an infinite army of Zombies. The fight wasn't hard, it was tedious. Every swing was the same hollow sound of metal on rotten bone.
BOOK_MAX_7_TEXT: His Thunder Blade was bored. He used his "Triple Blind Bat Leap" not to impress, but to end the fight five seconds faster.
BOOK_MAX_8_TEXT: When silence finally fell in the crypt, Max felt no relief. He felt a profound emptiness. The roar of monsters and the applause of crowds were just different sounds for the same loneliness.
BOOK_MAX_10_TEXT: He stopped hunting. He locked the legendary sword in a chest, which he buried at the foot of a nameless mountain. He sold his famous thunder-blue cloak, the one they said was arrow-proof, for a tankard of warm mead and a map that led nowhere.
BOOK_MAX_11_TEXT:
And so, he walked.

For seasons he didn't bother to count, Max Rook just walked. He no longer sought glory. He sought... silence. A silence that wasn't empty. He wanted a place where his hands, now calloused more by the handle of a woodcutter's axe than the hilt of his sword, could build something, and not just destroy.
BOOK_MAX_12_TEXT:
His journey ended in a wild clearing, forgotten in the middle of a vast forest. The place was green, untouched, but not peaceful. Goblins and Slimes—the echoes of his former work—infested the area.

That's when he heard the sound of an axe hitting... wrong.
BOOK_MAX_13_TEXT: Curious, he approached. And there, in the midst of the chaos, was the strangest sight of his long career: a pale, bowl-haired man with glasses on the tip of his nose, trying to read a heavy book while, with his other hand, attempting (and failing miserably) to fell a tree. He would read a line, sigh, swing the axe, and the ground would shake more than the tree.
BOOK_MAX_14_TEXT:
A small group of Goblins, drawn by the noise, began to emerge from the trees. The man, annoyed at the interruption of his reading, raised the axe all wrong, as if it were a club.

Max Rook sighed. He saw the chaos, the incompetence, and the danger. But, for the first time in decades, he saw something that wasn't a burden. It was a project.
BOOK_MAX_15_TEXT:
He looked at the ground. The Thunder Blade was leagues away. But right there, at his feet, was a good oak branch. Sturdy. Heavy.

Max smiled. The adventure was over. The work was about to begin.

ITEM_GOLD_INGOT_DESC: Shiny and valuable. Perfect for crafting special items. Bloomrise's coins aren't made of it, but they should be.
ITEM_GOBLINFANG_DESC: Sharp trophies ripped from a goblin's mouth. Not magical, just kind of scary.
ITEM_GOLDENKEY_DESC: Shiny, mysterious, and clearly important. Don't lose it.
ITEM_REFINEDWOOD_DESC: Wood crafted with care and precision, free of splinters and full of potential.
ITEM_STONE_DESC: A common rock, but with a thousand and one uses. Useful for building, throwing... or just keeping in your pocket for precaution.
ITEM_SLIMEBALL_DESC: A sticky sphere left by a slime. Smells weird. And the texture? Even weirder.
ITEM_BONE_DESC: A white and sturdy bone, probably from a skeleton. Honestly, I don't know why anyone would keep this.
ITEM_RATTAIL_DESC: A hairy and somewhat gross rat tail. Doesn't seem to have much use, but who knows?
ITEM_FUNGI_DESC: A strange mushroom produced by fungi in the cave. Said to have medicinal properties, but no one has tested it yet.
ITEM_ZOMBIEBRAINS_DESC: Still a bit mushy. Scientifically useless. Socially uncomfortable.
ITEM_GUIDE_DESC: A blue notebook stitched together with mismatched fabric. Inside, it holds important quests for the whole village — and, at the end... a few oddly specific tips. The handwriting is neat, but you're not quite sure whose it is.
ITEM_SNAKEVENOM_DESC: A greenish liquid taken from serpent fangs. Slowly weakens whoever comes in contact.
ITEM_TRAVELAMULET_HOME_DESC: An ancient medallion that channels energy to take Rayy back to the front of her house. Using it drains all of Rayy’s energy.
ITEM_TRAVELAMULET_CAVE_DESC: An ancient medallion that channels energy to take Rayy to the front of the Mystic Cave entrance. Using it drains all of Rayy’s energy.
ITEM_TRAVELAMULET_DUNGEON_DESC: An ancient medallion that channels energy to take Rayy to the front of the dungeon entrance. Using it drains all of Rayy’s energy.
ITEM_TRAVELAMULET_BEACH_DESC: An ancient medallion that channels energy to take Rayy to the front of the beach. Using it drains all of Rayy’s energy.
ITEM_CORDA_DESC: A sturdy rope, made to withstand weight and tension. Useful for crafting certain items.
ITEM_PAPEL_USADO_DESC: A crumpled piece of paper, with some scribbled notes. Looks like someone was trying to remember something important, but seems kind of useless now.
ITEM_PARAFUSO_DESC: A metal screw, used to fasten things. Might be useful in repairs or constructions in the future.
ITEM_CPU_DESC: A small electronic chip, with complex circuits. Probably part of some unknown technological device.
ITEM_BATTERY_DESC: A compact battery, capable of storing electrical energy. Can be used to power electronic devices.
ITEM_GOLD_ORE_DESC: A shiny and valuable ore, can be processed in the forge to create a gold bar.
ITEM_IRON_ORE_DESC: A common and sturdy ore, can be processed in the forge to create an iron bar.
ITEM_BEER_DESC: Foamy and relaxing. Maybe it doesn't cure everything, but it soothes the mind and body.
ITEM_CHOCOLATE_DESC: Sweet melted happiness. Restores your soul and a bit of health.
ITEM_ICECREAM_DESC: Cold, sweet, and creamy. A burst of freshness that melts your worries away.
ITEM_PICOLE_DESC: Cold, sweet, and refreshing. Perfect for hot days and broken hearts.
ITEM_COOKIE_DESC: A crunchy snack. Restores a bit of hope and some good memories.
ITEM_MILKSHAKE_DESC: Cold, sweet, and so good it even heals a broken heart.
ITEM_ONIGIRI_DESC: A rice ball with a taste of home.
ITEM_SUSHI_DESC: Raw, sophisticated, and questionably fresh. Everyone should try it at least once.
ITEM_TACO_DESC: A mysterious mix of meat and spices. Lifts the spirits of any adventurer.
ITEM_COFFEE_DESC: Bitter, hot, and dangerously effective. Restores 4 Stamina and increases alertness (or anxiety).
ITEM_FIZZCOLA_DESC: Sweet, dark and full of fizz — in body and mood. Gives you an instant smile!
ITEM_SODA_DESC: Sweet, electric bubbles bottled up. Ruins your teeth but it's worth it, I guess.
ITEM_STAWBERRYDRINK_DESC: Sweet, pink and full of energy. Always a good choice to recharge your batteries.
ITEM_TURBIX_DESC: A sip of this energy drink makes the world seem faster. Perfect for when you need an extra boost.
ITEM_IRON_AXE_DESC: A heavy but reliable iron axe. Perfect for chopping wood or goblin heads.
ITEM_BOW_DESC: A wooden bow with decent aim. Not winning any contests but gets the job done... eventually.
ITEM_COMMON_ARROW_DESC: A simple arrow, made of wood and a stone tip. It's not the best, but it's better than nothing.
ITEM_IRONPICKAXE_DESC: Made for breaking rocks. Might even break your back. Use responsibly.
ITEM_RAYY_SWORD_DESC: Solid, sharp, and satisfying to swing. The faithful sword forged by someone special who didn't quite know what they were doing, but did a great job!
ITEM_GOLD_SWORD_DESC: Shiny and elegant. Its golden edge isn't just for looks, offering cutting power superior to the original sword.
ITEM_AMETIST_SWORD_DESC: Enchanted with amethyst, it glows softly. Its mystical aura grants a cut more potent than gold and extends its reach slightly.
ITEM_ESMERALMA_SWORD_DESC: Made of soulmerald, it glows intensely. Its channeled energy results in strikes notably stronger than amethyst and increases its reach considerably.
ITEM_WOOD_PICKAXE_DESC: A simple wooden pickaxe. Not very efficient, but it gets the job done.
ITEM_WOOD_AXE_DESC: A basic wooden axe. Ideal for chopping small trees and making firewood.
ITEM_CHROMITE_AXE_DESC: An axe made of chromite, rare and sturdy. Perfect for chopping down robust trees and facing dangerous creatures.
ITEM_CHROMITE_PICKAXE_DESC: A pickaxe made of chromite, sturdy and effective. Ideal for mining hard ores and facing underground challenges.

QUEST_TUTORIAL_DESC: J.Minelli suggested making an ax to help with the adventure, buy 2 wooden logs from his store and make a wooden ax to start exploring.
QUEST_IRON_HEART_DESC: Darius wants to create armor that "breathes". He says the secret is in the local iron ore. I just think he wants to see me mining.
QUEST2_START_DARIUS_1: Hey Rayy! I have a project for articulated armor, but the iron I have here is very brittle. I need two pieces of raw iron.
QUEST2_START_DARIUS_2: Hinged armor? Won't this make a rattling old tin noise every time I walk?
QUEST2_START_DARIUS_3: If I get the alloy right, it will sound like music! Bring me the iron and I promise I won't turn you into a walking bell.
QUEST2_PROGRESS_DARIUS_1: Did you get the iron? I'm looking forward to starting work!
QUEST2_PROGRESS_DARIUS_2: I'm still looking. The iron is difficult, but I'm already rehearsing the sound of old tin.
QUEST2_END_DARIUS_1: Here it is. Pure iron, straight from the source. My back says so.
QUEST2_END_DARIUS_2: Perfect! Look at that opaque shine... this thing will even withstand a bear bite.
QUEST2_END_DARIUS_3: I just hope the armor's "music" is very quiet heavy metal.
QUEST2_ONCOMPLETE_DARIUS_1: The armor project is moving forward. Come back later if you want to see the result (or test her resistance).
QUEST_ONCOOLDOWN_DARIUS_2: I'm still banging the hammer on that iron alloy. The noise is too loud even for me. Give my ears a break!
QUEST_GOLDEN_GLOW_DESC: Darius insists that gold is a great conductor of magic. He wants two ores to plate a shield. Ostentation or strategy?
QUEST3_START_DARIUS_1: Rayy, I had a vision! A shield that dispels spells using threads of pure gold. I need two gold ores right now!
QUEST3_START_DARIUS_2: Gold? Darius, if I show up with a gold shield in the dungeon, the monsters will assault me ​​before they attack me.
QUEST3_START_DARIUS_3: It's science, Rayy! Gold attracts magic away from you. It's a sacrifice... brilliant. Check it out?
QUEST3_PROGRESS_DARIUS_1: Hey Rayy, did you find my golden driver?
QUEST3_PROGRESS_DARIUS_2: Calm! Gold doesn't grow on trees, and the caves aren't making it easy.
QUEST3_END_DARIUS_1: I found what you wanted. Try not to spend everything on rings for your ego.
QUEST3_END_DARIUS_2: Look at this... the purity of it! I'll start the wiring right away. I think Max will be a good guinea pig to test in combat!
QUEST3_END_DARIUS_3: Yeah... apart from the fact that he'll forget the shield somewhere, I think it'll work.
QUEST3_ONCOMPLETE_DARIUS_1: The shield is almost ready. If it works (and he doesn't forget where he left it), you'll thank me later.
QUEST_ONCOOLDOWN_DARIUS_3: Working with gold requires patience and light hands. If I miss a thread, the shield explodes. You better come back later.
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_DESC: Lupi thinks the ants are hot and wants to collect 10 leaves to make natural fans. He seems very serious about this.
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_START_1: RAYY! Have you ever seen how ants run? They're overheating, I feel it!
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_START_2: Lupi, they're ants... they live underground, where it's cool.
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_START_3: No no! They need "Ant Fans"! If you bring me 10 of these fresh green leaves, I'll start making them now!
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_PROGRESS_1: Did you get the flaps? The ants are sweating, Rayy! I swear I saw one asking for ice cream!
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_PROGRESS_2: I'm getting it, Lupi! Leaves don't run away, but 10 is a lot.
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_END_1: Here are your "Ant Fans". Please do not try to feed ice cream to bugs.
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_END_2: Yay! Look at the aerodynamics of these little leaves! I'll distribute them all to the anthill nearby. They will love me!
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_END_3: I think they'll just carry the leaves into the hole to eat, but... have fun.
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_ONCOMPLETE_1: My mission was a success! The ants are... well, they took everything down. They must be setting up an air conditioning unit!
QUEST_LUPI_LEAVES_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I'm busy thinking about an "Umbrella for Ladybugs." Come back later, maybe I can come up with this.
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_DESC: Lupi wants to test whether the grapes are actually fairy eggs that glow in the dark. He needs 3 of them for his "research".
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_START_1: Rayy, Rayy! I found out! Grapes are not fruits, they are "Purple Globes of Joy"! Space seeds, for sure!
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_START_2: Lupi, I just saw Max eating a bunch of them. It's just grapes.
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_START_3: Max doesn't count... Can you bring me 3 of those Purple Globes and I'll prove that they glow if you squeeze them really hard!
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_PROGRESS_1: Did you find the Globes? My magnifying glass is ready for my observation!
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_PROGRESS_2: Not yet, the grapes still need to grow.
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_END_1: Here, Lupi. Three grapes. Try not to make too much of a mess with your "science."
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_END_2: OH! See how they react to light! If I crush one in my fur... oops, it's all sticky. But it's a space sticky!
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_END_3: Congratulations, Lupi. Now you're a Tanuki that smells like juice from a box.
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_ONCOMPLETE_1: The search didn't turn out very well. The Purple Globes are delicious, but they don't shine...
QUEST_LUPI_GRAPES_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I'm still trying to get the bruises off my belly... Come back later!
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_DESC: Wade broke the handle of his spare axe, and the carrying ropes rotted from the damp.
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_START_1: Rayy! Look at this state. I tried to lasso a stubborn oak tree and the rope snapped like it was made from a spider's web.
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_START_2: It seems like it's been a difficult day in the woods. And the axe? What happened to him?
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_START_3: I hit an oak knot that had the memory of iron. The cable couldn't handle it. Can you get me a new wooden ax and three reinforced ropes?
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_PROGRESS_1: I'm still here looking at the logs... Did you get the ropes and the ax I asked you for?
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_PROGRESS_2: I'm making the strings and looking for a good wood for the handle. I can hand it over to you now.
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_END_1: Here you go, Wade. New ropes and an ax ready for service.
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_END_2: Hah! Now yes. Feel the weight of this wood... the metal will fit like a glove here. And those ropes look like they could even hold a Troll.
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_END_3: Good to know. Try not to hit rocks this time, metal has memory, remember?
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_ONCOMPLETE_1: Thanks, girl. With these new tools, the village's firewood production is guaranteed for another month.
QUEST_WADE_SUPPLIES_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I'm still testing the strength of these strings. They're really good. Come back later to exchange some more ideas.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_DESC: Max claims that a clan of Goblins is trying to copy his legendary techniques. He wants you to eliminate them to "protect the exclusivity" of his moves.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_START_1: Rayy! Did you see? Those Dungeon Goblins... they're trying to imitate my famous "Thunder Spin"! This is combat plagiarism!
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_START_2: Max, they were just carrying pieces of meat, they didn't seem to be training at all.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_START_3: That's exactly what they want you to think! Go out there and show them that there is only one Max. Defeat 5 of them while I sit here polishing my armor for the victory parade!
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_PROGRESS_1: Have you dismantled the unauthorized fan club? The world is not big enough for two sword masters!
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_PROGRESS_2: They're persistent, Max. But I'm taking care of it.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_PROGRESS_3: Be quick! If they learn my victory pose, I'll be ruined!
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_END_1: Goblins defeated, Max. None of them are left to copy your moves.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_END_2: Hah! Excellent. Did you see how they shook? It was my spiritual presence at your side that guaranteed success. You can go now, I have to rehearse my speech to the pigeons.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_END_3: Of course, Max... your "spiritual presence" was fundamental.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_ONCOMPLETE_1: Balance has been restored. Now the world knows that there is only one living legend in Bloomrise.
QUEST_MAX_GOBLINS_ONCOOLDOWN_1: Shhh! I am meditating on how to defeat an army of ants that dare march into my garden. Come back later.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_DESC: Max says that the snakes in the area are "whispering insults" about the shine of his armor. He sends you to silence criticism.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_START_1: Rayy, did you hear? They are hissing... the snakes are conspiring against my heroic style!
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_START_2: Snakes don't conspire, Max. They just hiss. And his armor doesn't even shine that much, it's full of rust.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_START_3: That's battle patina! Those legless creatures are jealous of my height. Defeat 3 of them so I can walk triumphantly without being judged!
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_PROGRESS_1: Did you manage to silence the gossips in the dungeons? I feel like they're still laughing at my cover!
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_PROGRESS_2: It's hard to hit something that crawls so fast, but I'll do it.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_PROGRESS_3: Look into their eyes! They hate staring contests. I would do that, but my gaze is too powerful for small animals.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_END_1: Free way, Max. The snakes won't bother your "stature" anymore.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_END_2: Did you see that? Order was restored. Now I can pose by the lake without hearing disapproving hisses.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_END_3: Enjoy your moment of peace... and your "battle patina".
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_ONCOMPLETE_1: Nature is beautiful when it knows its place before a legend like me. Good job, apprentice.
QUEST_MAX_SNAKES_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I need to practice my steady, threatening stare. The pigeons are getting abused again.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_DESC: Max believes the skeletons in the dungeon are old rivals who have returned for a revenge. He sends you as his "emissary of destruction."
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_START_1: They're back, Rayy! The ancient warriors I defeated decades ago have risen! They're challenging me to a bone duel in the dungeon!
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_START_2: Max, these skeletons will attack anyone. I don't think they remember you.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_START_3: Of course they remember! See how they chatter their teeth! It's code for "we want Max." Go out there and give them the ultimate retirement. Defeat 4 of them for me while I prepare my mental counterattack.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_PROGRESS_1: I still hear the rattling of bones... Are you being too pious to the dead, girl?
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_PROGRESS_2: Skeletons are hard to fall, but I'm sending them all back to the ground.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_PROGRESS_3: Hit the joints! Without knees, an evil legend is nothing more than a useless pile of calcium!
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_END_1: Your "rivals" have been duly dismantled, Max.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_END_2: Hah! I knew they were no match for my influence! You fought well, but their fear of me was the final blow.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_END_3: I'll pretend to believe that if you give me some peace for the next five minutes.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_ONCOMPLETE_1: The dead must stay dead, especially if they are envious like those.
QUEST_MAX_SKELETONS_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I feel a new legend being born... oh no, it's just the smell of Selene's tea. Come back another time!
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_DESC: Lyla was attacked by bats while trying to find the perfect angle for a sketch. Now she wants revenge (with elegance).
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_START_1: Rayy, help! I was just watching the sunset when... SHWISH! Hairy, noisy things tried to get tangled up in my hair!
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_START_2: Bats? They're usually harmless, Lyla. They're just hunting bugs.
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_START_3: Harmless?! One of them almost scraped my imported silk! Those creatures are an attack on fashion. Get rid of them before I have a nervous breakdown!
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_PROGRESS_1: Have you cleaned the sky of those leather freaks yet? I won't take a step outside the house until I hear even one "meep-meep" sound!
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_PROGRESS_2: I'm taking care of it. Bats are fast, but my sword is faster.
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_PROGRESS_3: Excellent. Try not to make too much mess. Monster blood is impossible to get out of the planter, darling.
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_END_1: There you go, Lyla. The neighborhood is free of its "winged enemies".
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_END_2: Oh, justice has finally been served! Now I can go back to parading... I mean, walking through the forest without looking like the protagonist of a horror movie.
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_END_3: Just try not to swing your arms too much next time. This attracts their attention.
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_ONCOMPLETE_1: The air even seems cleaner now. Without those frantic shadows ruining the scenery. Thank you, Rayy!
QUEST_LYLA_BATS_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I'm still touching up my makeup. That scare left me really pale, and it's not a "stylish" pale. Come back later!
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_DESC: Lyla needs pigments to create a new dye for her fabrics. She looks for the exact tone of the Big Blue Flowers in the forest.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_START_1: Rayy, I had an epiphany! Imagine a dress in the exact shade of the sky before the storm... but for that, I need those huge blue flowers.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_START_2: The Big Blue Flowers? They grow in somewhat humid places. You don't want to ruin your jump by going there.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_START_3: Exactly why you are here! Can you get 4 of them? They need to be intact, or the pigment loses its “finesse”.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_PROGRESS_1: Did you find the flowers? My palette is suffering from the lack of that blue, Rayy.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_PROGRESS_2: I'm still looking. They are rare and like to hide behind thorny bushes.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_PROGRESS_3: Thorns are so... inelegant. But make that sacrifice for art, will you?
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_END_1: Here they are, Lyla. Four blue flowers, without a single scratch on the petals.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_END_2: WONDERFUL! Look at this saturation! If I mix it with a little dew, I will have the color of the century!
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_END_3: I'm glad they served. Just don't go painting the whole town blue right now.
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_ONCOMPLETE_1: The color was divine. Marcus even commented that my new scarves have an "enigmatic" shine. Pure art!
QUEST_LYLA_FLOWERS_ONCOOLDOWN_1: Shhh! I'm in the middle of an intense creative process. The paint needs to dry and I need silence to get inspired!
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_DESC: Victor is trying to automate the village's accounting, but his current machine "stuck" when processing Lupi's seed taxes. It needs 2 CPUs to complete the upgrade.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_START_1: Miss Rayy. My calculations indicate an unacceptable bottleneck in processing village data. Efficiency dropped 8.4% this morning.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_START_2: Does this explain why your machine was emitting purple smoke when I passed the window?
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_START_3: The smoke was a... side effect of trying to process Lupi's chaotic logic. I need two central processing units, the CPUs. It would be very helpful if you could bring me these parts.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_PROGRESS_1: The current processor is operating at 110 degrees Celsius. Where are the components I requested?
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_PROGRESS_2: I'm searching through the dungeon's technological wreckage. It's not easy to find intact silicon there.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_PROGRESS_3: I understand. The chaos of the dungeon tends to fragment complex structures. Keep trying, the order of the village depends on it.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_END_1: Victor, here are the CPUs. Be careful not to drop them, they were difficult to get.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_END_2: Excellent. The integrity of the pins appears preserved. With this, I will be able to calculate the growth trajectory of the village in a matter of seconds.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_END_3: Just try not to make the library dance like that cow, please.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_ONCOMPLETE_1: The upgrade was a success. The calculation speed is now dizzying. I already predicted that you will trip over a tree root in the next 48 hours. Careful.
QUEST_VICTOR_CPU_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I'm still compiling the new security protocols. A powerful machine requires a vigilant mind. Come back when the logs are clean.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_DESC: Selene feels that the dungeon's negative energies are "hitchhiking" into the village. She wants two Soulmeralds to create a spiritual filter in the bar.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_START_1: Rayy, do you notice how the lights seem to shine less today? The fatigue of those returning from the depths is heavy in the air.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_START_2: The atmosphere is really heavy. Any ideas on how to clear this energy without using a bucket of water?
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_START_3: Soulmerald. Two of them would be enough. They absorb what is cloudy and return clarity. Could you bring them to me?
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_PROGRESS_1: Do you feel the weight in the air? The Soulmeralds would help ease this burden.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_PROGRESS_2: I'm still looking for them. Soulmeralds are not easy to find among ordinary stones.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_END_1: Here they are, Selene. Two Soulmerald stones, pure as you asked.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_END_2: Wonderful! See how the light dances within them. I will place them near the entrance to welcome those who arrive.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_END_3: The bar already seems a little lighter just looking at them. That was a great idea, Selene.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_ONCOMPLETE_1: Since we placed the stones, the fights have lessened and the smiles seem more sincere. Thanks again.
QUEST_SELENE_ESMERALMA_ONCOOLDOWN_1: The stones are still doing their cleaning work. For now, the bar is in harmony.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_DESC: Selene wants to give Marcus something that reminds him of the tranquility of the sea, so that he doesn't lose his natural calm on days in a crowded bar.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_START_1: Marcus is the bar's safe haven, but even harbors need care. He wanted something that reminded him of the sound of waves.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_START_2: A beach amulet? They are said to retain the whisper of the ocean.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_START_3: Exactly. An amulet like that under the counter would bring the breeze he misses so much. Could you get one for us?
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_PROGRESS_1: Were you able to smell the salt during your searches? The amulet would make a special gift.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_PROGRESS_2: Not yet, but I'm keeping an eye on every relic I find.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_PROGRESS_3: The sea delivers its treasures at the right time. I will wait.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_END_1: I found this amulet. It still smells of the sea and freedom.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_END_2: It's beautiful, Rayy. Marcus will love the gesture. It will help you stay calm when the mugs are clanking non-stop.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_END_3: He deserves it. A calm host makes all the difference to a weary adventurer.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_ONCOMPLETE_1: Marcus hung up the amulet and now it seems like he always has a cool breeze around him. An invaluable gift.
QUEST_SELENE_AMULET_ONCOOLDOWN_1: The amulet brought peace from the coast to our salon. Come back later for juice on the house.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_DESC: Marcus wants to surprise his customers (and maybe Selene) with a new refreshing juice recipe. He needs 4 fresh strawberries.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_START_1: Hey Rayy! It arrived at the right time. I was here thinking about how to give a special touch to the bar menu, but I lack raw materials.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_START_2: Let me guess: something sweet and refreshing? What's on your mind, Marcus?
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_START_3: Strawberries, the good ones! If you can bring me four of them, I can prepare that juice that makes people forget about their problems for a few minutes.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_PROGRESS_1: How is this harvest going? I can already smell the sweet in the air, all that's missing is the fruit.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_PROGRESS_2: I'm still on my way to the right bush. Wild strawberries like to hide.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_PROGRESS_3: Without rushing, fruit picked in a hurry never ripens well.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_END_1: Here they are, Marcus. Four strawberries, fresh and very red.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_END_2: Perfect! Just look at the shine on these ones. Selene will love the first glass, and the rest will go straight into the barrels.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_END_3: I'm happy to help. The bar always looks better when you're inspired by the kitchen.
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_ONCOMPLETE_1: The strawberry juice was an absolute success, Rayy. Even Marcus seemed more excited today. Thanks for the help!
QUEST_MARCUS_MORANGO_ONCOOLDOWN_1: I still have some strawberries in stock, but come by later. Hawke's hospitality never ends.
QUEST_BRAIN_IN_PLACE_DESC: Victor’s been obsessed with zombie brains. Said it’s for a project... or maybe just decoration. Either way, it’s probably best not to know.
QUEST_SWEET_MEMORIES_DESC: Marcus smelled a cookie and nearly cried. Seems like these cookies remind him of something important. Who knows...
QUEST_WOOD_HELP_DESC: Wade’s trying to fix a wonky fence. Said it’d be quick, but forgot to factor in his laziness. Give him a hand.
QUEST_STICKY_SERVICE_DESC: Minelli got slimed near the dungeon. Now she’s outraged — and wants someone to handle it. Someone like... you.
QUEST_WILD_SMILE_DESC: Darius asked for goblin fangs with a suspicious little smile. Didn’t say what for — and maybe that’s for the best.
QUEST_SUN_TEA_DESC: Lupi believes that sunflowers keep a little bit of sun inside them. He wants to make a 'sun tea' to cheer up the plants that stay indoors.
QUEST_SERENITY_TEA_DESC: Selene has noticed a tension in the village air. To help soothe everyone's nerves, she wants to prepare a special tea with forest flowers.
QUEST_COLOR_OF_INSPIRATION_DESC: Lyla is in the midst of her fashion creation. She needs an Amethyst to inspire and complete the piece, but caves are terribly bad for her hairstyle.
NOTES_ADVENTURER_DESC:
About shops:
Some villagers sell things, but only when they are near their workbenches.

About tasks:
Many people in the village will need a little help.
If you offer help from time to time, you might end up getting good things (or at least funny stories).
NOTES_TIPS_DESC:
- Select a weapon, get close and... hope you hit.

- Roll to dodge attacks. Conversations? Not always.

- Backpack full? Sell some junk and pretend it was strategy.

- The village changes. Pay attention or it will outsmart you.
QUEST_BARRELDESTRUCTION_DESC: Crates, barrels and mysterious jars are scattered across the dungeons, as if someone left them there on purpose. Might be a good idea to break them and see if they hide something useful...
QUEST_TALKAROUND_DESC: To understand a village, you can’t just look — you have to listen. Greet all the residents of Bloomrise and learn what each one carries in their heart (or hides behind a smile).
QUEST_ZOMBIECLEANUP_DESC: They move slow but stink fast. Zombies have been appearing in groups and bothering anyone trying to explore the dungeon. Time to put an end to this smelly problem and bring back some peace... and fresh air.
QUEST_SUSHICRISIS_DESC: Lyla wants to organize a 'super cultural' sushi event for everyone. The problem? No one told her fish runs out. Gathering 35 sushi might prevent a diplomatic (and culinary) catastrophe.
QUEST_VILLAGETASKS_DESC: Bloomrise is full of people with stories, routines... and requests! Many villagers need help now and then. Talk to them, accept a task, and show you're ready to make a difference here.
QUEST_CHROMITE_DESC: Legend says Chromite holds the essence of the world's first four colors. Few have seen one up close — fewer have touched it. Collecting one is impressive. Collecting many? Adventurers call it a miracle.
QUEST_LOGS_TITLE: Logs for Today, Fire for Tomorrow
QUEST_LOGS_DESC: Old Wade complained that it's hard to keep the fire going with so many trees growing around the village. Chop some down to clear the area and stock up on firewood for the days ahead.
QUEST_SLIMES_DESC: Slimes are multiplying all over. Fields, caves, even near the village! Things are getting way too slippery — literally.
QUEST_COOKIES_DESC: Wade swears he baked cookies for a community snack, but all that's left are suspicious crumbs and a Lupi with a full mouth. If you can gather 35 cookies, we can restock... or at least distract the guilty one with another.
QUEST_SODAS_DESC: The village’s soda machines mysteriously stopped working... again. While the inventor tries to “recalibrate the thermal carbon coolers,” someone needs to collect 35 sodas before thirst wins.
QUEST_ROCKS_DESC: While exploring, Rayy noticed some paths blocked by large stones. Breaking these rocks might open new paths... or hide secrets!
QUEST_GOBLINS_DESC: Some say goblins are just misunderstood. Others say they even stole the town bell. Either way, 60 of them need to go. Less chaos, more peace.
QUEST_GHOSTS_DESC: Villagers whisper about glowing figures wandering the Mysterious Forest at night. Some say it's just stories… others swear they heard wails. Defeat some ghosts and bring peace to those brave enough to go out at night.
QUEST_TURBIX_DESC: Marcus tried to replace Turbix with homemade mushroom tea. The result? An empty bar and one customer dancing nonstop for 3 hours. Better grab 35 cans and keep the place stocked with real caffeine.
QUEST_SNAKES_DESC: Snakes have started appearing on trails near the dungeons, slithering silently through rocks and grass. The problem? Each bite could mean the end of a careless adventurer. Best to reduce the danger before someone doesn’t make it back home.
QUEST_BATS_DESC: Bats have multiplied in the caves, bothering any adventurer passing through. Best to reduce the wing-flapping noise before someone goes mad — or gets bitten in the dark.
QUEST_CATCHTILAPIA_DESC: Freshwater Tilapia is famous for its light, tasty meat, making it a key ingredient in many village dishes. Skilled anglers who can bring in fresh Tilapia are always welcome at the inn!
QUEST_CATCHHERRING_DESC: Small, silver, and always in a group. Herring are a vital ocean fish, used in cooking and for making oils. Anglers often look for their large, shimmering schools near the coast at the beach.
QUEST_HARVESTCROPS_DESC: Farming is the lifeblood of Bloomrise. Contributing to the harvest helps everyone, from the general store to the inn's kitchen. Plant your seeds, tend to them, and harvest the fruits of your labor to help supply the village.
DIALOGUE_CAT_0: Well, well... So my husband's terrible noise was just you?
DIALOGUE_CAT_1: Did you come to hide from the cold or are you just keeping an eye on our pantry?
DIALOGUE_CAT_2: You seem to be looking for a home. And look, between J and me, you are by far the calmest creature in this house. Do you want to stay?
DIALOGUE_CAT_3: Well, if you're going to live here, you need a name... Hmm... how about 'Mister Whiskers'?
DIALOGUE_CAT_4: No, wait... you're a young lady. That name doesn't work...
DIALOGUE_CAT_5: I already know! 'Marin'. Sounds good, don't you think?
DIALOGUE_CAT_6: So it's decided. Welcome to the family, Marin! Now keep an eye on the house while I go to the Dungeon and see if I can find anything more dangerous than you.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_1: Rayy… I know I'm not a blacksmith, so I had to go to the village forge to get this sword for you. I did it with what little I know, but seeing you fight slimes inspired me.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_2: Did you go to the blacksmith? It's beautiful! A bit crooked, but it must cut better than my old tree branch, right?
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_3: It's not perfect, but it works. Remember to equip it before attacking the monsters, okay? In fact, I left a trunk there in our house. If you're hungry, you can use the stove to prepare something before you go.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_4: Food made, sword equipped. Any other recommendations, "boss"?
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_5: Several. If you need seeds, the flower shop near the flower field is open. And if you have time left, spend it at the library. I left some books there about the local fish and the monsters of Bloomrise.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_6: Read monster manuals? I thought we would learn by beating each other, as always.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_7: Knowledge is power, Rayy. There's even a book about the history of our land there. But listen... I heard a strange noise coming from inside the room just now.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_8: A noise inside the house? And you're standing here giving me botany lessons?
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_9: I was going to check, but I need to rush to open my store. Can you take a look please?
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_10: It can leave. After that I head to the Dungeon to the north, to the left of the village.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_11: That. If you get lost, open the Map. And take this here, the “Adventurer’s Guide”. I found it the other day and I think it will help you not to get so distracted by every flower you see along the way.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_12: Last thing, Rayy. I think it would be a good idea to start by making a wooden ax to get resources faster.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_13: I have some refined wood here and the rest in my store, and the creation bench is right there in the room, if you want to try making one.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_14: Thanks! I'll stop by your store later to pick up the materials. And... about the noise, I'll take a look when I make the axe.
DIALOGUE_TUTORIAL_15: Good luck, Rayy. He takes care of himself.
DIALOGUE1_JMINELLI_1: Do you think I could run the shop for a day?
DIALOGUE1_JMINELLI_2: Only if I can use your sword for a day.
DIALOGUE2_JMINELLI_1: I went to the dungeon today. Found some different things.
DIALOGUE2_JMINELLI_2: Save some for me. What if they become trendy.
DIALOGUE3_JMINELLI_2: Whatever you want, the wife discount is on!
DIALOGUE4_JMINELLI_1: Look... a crafting bench in the living room. A bold touch of domestic chaos. I admire the courage.
DIALOGUE4_JMINELLI_2: Just be careful not to confuse the hammer with the fork. It's happened to me. I don't recommend it.
DIALOGUE4_JMINELLI_3: I'm still learning... But if it works out, maybe I'll make a basement for my stuff.
DIALOGUE5_JMINELLI_1: You know I love it when you make a joke at the right time.
DIALOGUE5_JMINELLI_2: It's my way of keeping the peace. And getting discounts at the shop.
DIALOGUE6_JMINELLI_1: I hope you're not giving Wade better discounts than me.
DIALOGUE6_JMINELLI_2: He brings me resources. You bring me love. It's a fair deal.
DIALOGUE7_JMINELLI_1: I brought what you wanted: your favorite chocolate.
DIALOGUE7_JMINELLI_2: You really know how to win a warrior's heart.
DIALOGUE7_JMINELLI_3: Only the best for my heroine.
DIALOGUE8_JMINELLI_1: You still have those paints you bought from Lupi, right?
DIALOGUE8_JMINELLI_2: I do. And I still use them. Painted some butterflies just the other day.
DIALOGUE8_JMINELLI_3: I saw from afar. It looked good, you know? A bit crooked, a bit too colorful... but good. It has your face on it.
DIALOGUE8_JMINELLI_4: Crooked and too colorful is my official style, thank you.
DIALOGUE8_JMINELLI_5: Yeah. And for some reason, it fits the whole village.
DIALOGUE9_JMINELLI_1: Have you ever thought about taking a day off?
DIALOGUE9_JMINELLI_2: I have. But then I remembered you'd spend it all at the other shop.
DIALOGUE10_JMINELLI_2: Organization is art. You should try it.
DIALOGUE11_JMINELLI_1: I love listening to the older villagers’ stories.
DIALOGUE11_JMINELLI_2: They always have something interesting to tell.
DIALOGUE12_JMINELLI_1: I was thinking we could stop by Selene’s later.
DIALOGUE12_JMINELLI_2: Great idea. Her sunflower tea works wonders after a long day.
DIALOGUE13_JMINELLI_1: Rayy, don’t forget to bring a snack. Dungeons work up an appetite.
DIALOGUE13_JMINELLI_2: Got it, master of supplies. I’ll be back before you even miss me.
QUEST1_START_JMINELLI_1: Rayy, I heard some slimes are spreading inside the dungeon... and you know how they are, right? They slip into everything, even the village's reputation.
QUEST1_START_JMINELLI_2: If you can take out two of them for me, I promise a reward... like a cookie! But come back here after, okay?
QUEST1_ONCOMPLETE_JMINELLI_1: You already took care of that mission, remember? Enjoy your well-deserved rest!
QUEST_ONCOOLDOWN_JMINELLI_1: I'm still putting things back in order after your last help, Rayy. Those slimes made quite a mess!
QUEST1_PROGRESS_JMINELLI_1: Have you dealt with the slimes near the dungeon yet?
QUEST1_PROGRESS_JMINELLI_2: If not, watch your step... One of them almost took my apple box today.
QUEST1_PROGRESS_JMINELLI_3: I'm already on their trail. If they slip away again, it'll be far from here.
QUEST1_END_JMINELLI_1: Mission accomplished! Two less slimes roaming the dungeon.
QUEST1_END_JMINELLI_2: Good! Now I can walk around there without becoming part of the floor... or the wall.
QUEST1_END_JMINELLI_3: Here's your reward — and thanks for always getting the job done.
QUEST1_START_VICTOR_1: Rayy… I have a slightly… peculiar task, if you’re up for it.
QUEST1_START_VICTOR_2: As long as it’s less disgusting than cleaning Selene’s cow pen, go ahead.
QUEST1_START_VICTOR_3: I need two zombie brains. Academic reasons. And no, not to decorate the library. (This time.)
QUEST1_ONCOMPLETE_VICTOR_1: The village appreciates your efficiency. This task won’t be necessary again. For now.
QUEST_ONCOOLDOWN_VICTOR_1: The brains are still… twitching. I need time to analyze. Your previous help was more than enough — for now.
QUEST1_PROGRESS_VICTOR_2: If they try to talk to you, run.
QUEST1_PROGRESS_VICTOR_3: If a brain says good morning to me, I’m quitting and becoming a florist.
QUEST1_END_VICTOR_1: Here they are… two squishy brains with a somewhat offensive smell.
QUEST1_END_VICTOR_2: Excellent. With this, I will be able to advance my studies on zombie cognition.
QUEST1_END_VICTOR_3: Thanks for the help, Rayy. I promise I won't try to make a real zombie... at least for now.
QUEST1_START_MARCUS_1: Hmm. The other day, while sorting through some old papers… I found a note from my sister. Along with a crumb. Cinnamon cookie.
QUEST1_START_MARCUS_2: Don’t get me wrong, I’m not the sentimental type. But some memories… deserve a second bite.
QUEST1_START_MARCUS_3: If you happen to come across some cookies, could you bring me six? Purely for scientific curiosity, of course.
QUEST1_ONCOMPLETE_MARCUS_1: Those cookies… stayed in my memory. Both literally and emotionally. I don’t need more. One good memory is enough.
QUEST1_ONCOMPLETE_MARCUS_2: That’s a relief. The way you said it, I thought I’d have to open a bakery.
QUEST_ONCOOLDOWN_MARCUS_1: Still digesting the last cookies… and the memories. They were surprisingly necessary, Rayy.
QUEST1_PROGRESS_MARCUS_1: Haven’t found all six cookies yet? That’s okay. Nostalgia can wait a bit longer.
QUEST1_PROGRESS_MARCUS_2: I’m hunting them down. Just hope I don’t eat one by accident...
QUEST1_END_MARCUS_1: Five cookies. Almost identical to the old ones.
QUEST1_END_MARCUS_2: Thank you, Rayy. I… needed that.
QUEST1_END_MARCUS_3: Just don’t go telling people I’m hoarding sweets for sentimental reasons.
QUEST1_END_MARCUS_4: No judgment. And your secret’s safe with me — as long as I can keep one of those cookies.
QUEST1_START_WADE_1: Rayy, I’m running low on wood to finish some things around here.
QUEST1_START_WADE_2: If you could gather a few wood logs for me, that’d really help.
QUEST1_ONCOMPLETE_WADE_1: You’ve helped enough with that already. If I need more, I promise I’ll let you know — ahead of time!
QUEST_ONCOOLDOWN_WADE_1: The wood you brought is still going strong! Don’t worry, I’ll call you as soon as I need more.
QUEST1_PROGRESS_WADE_1: Were you able to chop down a few trees?
QUEST1_PROGRESS_WADE_2: On my way. Trying not to get attacked by trees with legs.
QUEST1_END_WADE_1: Here are the logs. Three, just like you asked — whole and (I think) termite-free.
QUEST1_END_WADE_2: Perfect! That should be enough for... hmm... maybe another bench.
QUEST1_START_DARIUS_1: Rayy, I’m testing a new attachment for a weapon… but I’ll need some goblin fangs. Two will do.
QUEST1_START_DARIUS_2: Goblin fangs? Fancy. Do weapons have teeth now?
QUEST1_START_DARIUS_3: Something like that. Let’s call it aggressive aesthetics. Think you can grab a few for me?
QUEST1_ONCOMPLETE_DARIUS_1: What you already brought was more than enough. If I cook up another crazy idea, I’ll let you know.
QUEST_ONCOOLDOWN_DARIUS_1: The fangs you brought are in testing. I’m checking if the weapon doesn’t start biting on its own. Thanks for bringing them so fast!
QUEST1_PROGRESS_DARIUS_2: Not yet. Turns out goblins aren’t too keen on the idea, who knew?
QUEST1_END_DARIUS_1: Here they are. Pulled them carefully… as much as possible… no one flew off.
QUEST1_END_DARIUS_2: Perfect. These will fit nicely. Thanks, Rayy.
QUEST1_END_DARIUS_3: Now let’s see if a weapon with teeth actually bites better.
QUEST4_START_LUPI_1: Rayy! I've discovered the secret to happy plants! It's the sun! But what about the ones that stay indoors?
QUEST4_START_LUPI_2: Are you going to... carry the sun indoors, Lupi?
QUEST4_START_LUPI_3: Almost! I'm going to make sunflower tea! They're basically portable suns. If you bring some, I can make sun tea so everyone feels warm and happy!
QUEST4_ONCOMPLETE_LUPI_1: I don't need any more sunflowers for now, Rayy! The last tea was so strong my ferns got a tan!
QUEST4_ONCOOLDOWN_LUPI_1: The plants are still absorbing the 'light' from the last tea. They told me they're full of energy! They need some time to use it all on new leaves!
QUEST4_PROGRESS_LUPI_1: Have you found the little suns yet?
QUEST4_PROGRESS_LUPI_2: Not yet. They're shyer than they look.
QUEST4_PROGRESS_LUPI_3: Try singing to them! They like music and open up more easily!
QUEST4_END_LUPI_1: I brought the sunflowers. They're warm, just like you said.
QUEST4_END_LUPI_2: They're perfect! Look, you can feel the sun's energy in them! My plants are going to have a party!
QUEST4_END_LUPI_3: Thanks, Rayy! Want a sip of the tea when it's ready? It tastes like a summer day!
QUEST5_START_SELENE_1: Rayy, have you felt it too? There's a restless quiet in the village lately. People smile, but their eyes are tired.
QUEST5_START_SELENE_2: Now that you mention it... it feels like everyone is holding their breath. What are you planning to do?
QUEST5_START_SELENE_3: Sometimes, a warm cup of tea listens more than a thousand words. I need some flowers from the forest... the small blue and purple ones. They help calm the heart.
QUEST5_ONCOMPLETE_SELENE_1: The tea you helped make brought a lot of peace, Rayy. For now, the village is breathing easier.
QUEST5_ONCOOLDOWN_SELENE_1: I still have some of the flowers you brought. Their scent alone calms the bar. When I need more, I'll let you know.
QUEST5_PROGRESS_SELENE_1: Have you managed to find the flowers for the tea?
QUEST5_PROGRESS_SELENE_2: I'm looking. They're more discreet than I remembered.
QUEST5_PROGRESS_SELENE_3: The best things usually are. Be patient in your search.
QUEST5_END_SELENE_1: Selene, here are the flowers you asked for.
QUEST5_END_SELENE_2: Ah, perfect. Their scent already brings a bit of peace. Thank you, Rayy.
QUEST5_END_SELENE_3: This won't solve the world's problems, but it will warm the souls of those who need it. It's a start.
QUEST7_START_LYLA_1: Rayy, darling! An artistic emergency! I'm creating a dress that will revolutionize Bloomrise fashion, but it's... muted!
QUEST7_START_LYLA_2: A muted dress? Is it refusing to speak to you?
QUEST7_START_LYLA_3: Exactly! It needs a pop of color, of inspiration! An Amethyst! That shade of purple is precisely what I need. I'd go myself, but the cave's humidity...
QUEST7_ONCOMPLETE_LYLA_1: That Amethyst was a milestone in my career, darling. But fashion never stops! I'm already onto a new color palette now.
QUEST7_ONCOOLDOWN_LYLA_1: I'm still processing the energy from the last stone. Inspiration is like a good perfume, don't rush it. Come back later, maybe the fashion muse will visit me again.
QUEST7_PROGRESS_LYLA_1: So? My masterpiece is on hold, waiting for its touch of glamour.
QUEST7_PROGRESS_LYLA_2: I'm looking, Lyla. Fancy rocks don't grow on trees.
QUEST7_PROGRESS_LYLA_3: Think of my dress, Rayy! It's naked without the Amethyst! It's a matter of decency!
QUEST7_END_LYLA_1: Lyla, your stone. Be careful not to trip over it in those shoes.
QUEST7_END_LYLA_2: Oh, it's perfect! So dramatic! The light hits it and creates a spectacle! I can already see the complete design!
QUEST7_END_LYLA_3: Thank you, Rayy! You didn't save the world, but you saved my look. Which, let's be honest, is almost the same thing.
DIALOGUE1_WADE_1: Is that a callus or a tattoo on your hand?
DIALOGUE1_WADE_2: If it hurts, it's a callus. If it itches, then I worry.
DIALOGUE2_WADE_2: Always. Trees don't rest, and neither do I.
DIALOGUE3_WADE_1: Have you ever seen what happens when a goblin tries to chop wood?
DIALOGUE3_WADE_2: No, but I imagine it's a disaster.
DIALOGUE4_WADE_2: It's my scent — essence of fresh forest.
DIALOGUE5_WADE_1: You and Minelli still trade supplies for discounts?
DIALOGUE5_WADE_2: Yep. He gets shelves, I get discounts. Teamwork.
DIALOGUE6_WADE_1: Do you always whistle while you work?
DIALOGUE6_WADE_2: Only when the wood is in a good mood. If not, it's just a weird noise.
DIALOGUE7_WADE_1: Did you see the weather today? Perfect for a walk.
DIALOGUE7_WADE_2: I did. But this pile of logs isn't going to move itself.
DIALOGUE_WR_2_WADE_1: Hey, Rayy! You swing that sword like you're chopping firewood! Hah!
DIALOGUE_WR_2_RAYY_1: Is that a compliment or a criticism?
DIALOGUE_WR_2_WADE_2: It's a compliment! Firewood is tough to cut!
DIALOGUE_WR_3_RAYY_1: Wade, have you ever fought a... Fungi? That purple mushroom?
DIALOGUE_WR_3_WADE_1: (Scratches beard) My axe turned purple for a week. And I sneezed for three days. Weird stuff.
DIALOGUE_WR_3_WADE_2: (Scratches his beard) My ax was purple for a week. And I sneezed for three days. Strange thing.
DIALOGUE_WR_4_RAYY_1: You're strong, Wade. You should come to the dungeon with me.
DIALOGUE_WR_4_WADE_1: Hah! My dungeon days are over, kid. I'd rather fight an oak knot than a Zombie.
DIALOGUE9_WADE_15: What makes an axe last so long in your hands?
DIALOGUE9_WADE_16: Constant cleaning and never striking stones. Metal has a memory, girl.
DIALOGUE10_WADE_17: Can you teach me how to reinforce the structure of my house?
DIALOGUE10_WADE_18: Bring the logs and the tools. Work teaches more than conversation.
DIALOGUE11_WADE_21: Wade, how do you know which tree is ready to be cut?
DIALOGUE11_WADE_22: By the sound of the bark when I strike it. The tree tells you when the cycle ends.
DIALOGUE1_DARIUS_1: The village has been quieter, hasn't it?
DIALOGUE1_DARIUS_2: Yeah... I hope it lasts. But it's always good to keep the sword sharp.
DIALOGUE2_DARIUS_2: My arms? Never. My patience? Often.
DIALOGUE3_DARIUS_1: Has this forge ever melted something it shouldn't?
DIALOGUE4_DARIUS_1: I heard you want to create some things at your crafting bench at home. Just don't forget the blacksmith here, okay?
DIALOGUE4_DARIUS_2: There are things that only fire and the right arm can do. And modesty aside... I have both.
DIALOGUE4_DARIUS_3: I promise not to steal all your customers. Just two or three.
DIALOGUE5_DARIUS_1: How many hammers do you have, exactly?
DIALOGUE5_DARIUS_2: Counting the decorative ones... there must be about 10.
DIALOGUE6_DARIUS_1: Do you have more customers besides me, Darius?
DIALOGUE6_DARIUS_2: Once Lupi bought a paper sword. But I don't know if that counts.
DIALOGUE7_DARIUS_1: Have you ever thought about making weapons with different materials?
DIALOGUE7_DARIUS_2: Yes. Once I tried with chocolate. It was a failure... but delicious.
DIALOGUE8_DARIUS_1: Have you ever thought about making jewelry, Darius?
DIALOGUE8_DARIUS_2: If it's made of cast iron, I might consider it.
DIALOGUE9_DARIUS_1: You're the best blacksmith I know!
DIALOGUE9_DARIUS_2: It better be. My pompadour depends on it.
DIALOGUE_DR_3_RAYY_1: Darius, can you make... glitter armor? Lyla won't stop suggesting it.
DIALOGUE_DR_3_DARIUS_1: (He stares at Rayy for five seconds.) ...No.
DIALOGUE1_JADEN_2: Always. Greatness doesn't take a nap.
DIALOGUE2_JADEN_1: Are you going to sing at the bar today?
DIALOGUE2_JADEN_2: If inspiration strikes... or if someone buys me a hibiscus tea.
DIALOGUE3_JADEN_1: Have you ever thought about making a song about the village?
DIALOGUE3_JADEN_2: I have. But I haven't found the right melody yet. Maybe I need more adventures.
DIALOGUE4_JADEN_1: Do you sleep with your hair like that or does it just style itself when you wake up?
DIALOGUE4_JADEN_2: It's natural talent. Just like my voice.
DIALOGUE5_JADEN_1: Do you remember that song about a cow that became a star?
DIALOGUE5_JADEN_2: Who would forget? It was a country hit.
DIALOGUE6_JADEN_1: Do you always rehearse lines by yourself?
DIALOGUE6_JADEN_2: I'm not alone. I'm with the imaginary audience. They're very understanding.
DIALOGUE7_JADEN_1: Are you always this confident, or is it acting?
DIALOGUE7_JADEN_2: If I tell you, it ruins the mystery.
DIALOGUE8_JADEN_1: Your hair is especially... square today.
DIALOGUE8_JADEN_2: That's not hair, it's style with attitude.
DIALOGUE1_LUPI_1: This plant here... looks pretty normal.
DIALOGUE1_LUPI_2: That's what it wants you to think.
DIALOGUE2_LUPI_1: Lupi, why do your paints smell like fruit?
DIALOGUE2_LUPI_2: Nature's mystery! Or maybe I used strawberry juice by accident.
DIALOGUE2_LUPI_4: It's art with aroma, Rayy. A future trend!
DIALOGUE3_LUPI_1: Lupi... did you really have a turtle? Or was that just something you made up?
DIALOGUE3_LUPI_2: I did! Her name was Tartalina. Small, calm... she always slept curled up by my feet.
DIALOGUE3_LUPI_3: One day, I left the lid of her box slightly open. Thought she wouldn’t mind. But... when I came back, she was already gone.
DIALOGUE3_LUPI_5: Thinking she’s out there living an adventure helps a little.
DIALOGUE3_LUPI_6: If she ever shows up, I’m sure she’ll know how to find her way back home.
DIALOGUE4_LUPI_1: What’s in your bag right now?
DIALOGUE4_LUPI_2: Secrets, snacks, and a possibly cursed seed. Want one?
DIALOGUE4_LUPI_3: Thanks, but I think that seed belongs in your magical chaos collection…
DIALOGUE5_LUPI_1: What are you planting today, Lupi?
DIALOGUE5_LUPI_2: Found this weird seed behind the market! Could be a MegaSolarFruit or a LettuceRock. I’ll name it once it grows a face!
DIALOGUE6_LUPI_1: Looks like it’s going to rain today.
DIALOGUE6_LUPI_2: Perfect! Seeds dance better in the rain.
DIALOGUE7_LUPI_1: Did you dig holes behind the barn again?
DIALOGUE7_LUPI_2: Maybe. It was for a “controlled botanical experiment.”
DIALOGUE8_LUPI_1: You like spending time with Milo, huh?
DIALOGUE8_LUPI_2: He’s like… a silent thunder! Super calm, but you feel he’s thinking amazing thoughts. I talk a lot so he doesn’t have to say anything!
DIALOGUE9_LUPI_1: Did you really plant that strange seed right in the middle of the path?
DIALOGUE9_LUPI_2: Yes! That way, everyone can watch it grow! And if danger sprouts… I’ll just give it a hug. Usually works. Like… 80% of the time!
DIALOGUE10_LUPI_1: Are you sure that seed isn’t just a rock?
DIALOGUE10_LUPI_2: Only one way to find out… plant it!
DIALOGUE_LPR_1_LUPI_1: Rayy! You who wanders... have you ever seen a plant that blinks when you whistle?
DIALOGUE_LPR_1_LUPI_2: Yours don't. Mine are almost there.
DIALOGUE_LPR_2_LUPI_1: The Slimes aren't evil. They're just... damp and confused. They remind me of a type of sentient moss.
DIALOGUE_LPR_2_RAYY_1: The 'sentient moss' tried to eat me yesterday.
DIALOGUE_LPR_2_LUPI_2: Exactly! Like a carnivorous bromeliad. Fascinating!
DIALOGUE1_LYLA_2: Obviously. A day without fashion is a day wasted.
DIALOGUE2_LYLA_1: Rayy… I saw something in the forest last night. A white figure, standing still… vanished when I blinked.
DIALOGUE2_LYLA_2: And did you go after it?
DIALOGUE2_LYLA_3: Of course not! I'm an artist, not an exorcist.
DIALOGUE3_LYLA_2: I thought it was the mountain… but no, it's the wind. Definitely the wind.
DIALOGUE4_LYLA_2: I still trip over stones. But now I trip with elegance.
DIALOGUE5_LYLA_1: Everything okay, Lyla? I saw you glaring at one of the cows like it insulted you.
DIALOGUE5_LYLA_2: It chased me, Rayy. Back in the city, the only things that run are on fire—or fashionable.
DIALOGUE6_LYLA_1: Have you ever thought of learning to fight?
DIALOGUE6_LYLA_2: I have. Fought over clearance shelves, limited edition heels... deeply traumatic.
DIALOGUE7_LYLA_2: A cactus. It died. But it looked fabulous.
DIALOGUE8_LYLA_1: Have you tried cooking something from the village?
DIALOGUE8_LYLA_2: Yes! The smoke was quite pretty. That’s progress.
DIALOGUE9_LYLA_1: Lyla, do you think this backpack matches my gear?
DIALOGUE9_LYLA_2: It’s functional, I’ll admit. But a ribbon bow would do wonders for your look.
DIALOGUE_LR_1_LYLA_1: Rayy, dear. Your courage is a 10/10. But those overalls... are a 2/10.
DIALOGUE_LR_1_RAYY_1: It works for fighting Slimes. Would your glitter dress work?
DIALOGUE_LR_1_LYLA_2: Of course! The sparkle would daze them. Think about it. 'Tactical distraction'.
DIALOGUE_LR_2_LYLA_1: I saw you training with your sword earlier. It was... energetic.
DIALOGUE_LR_2_RAYY_1: I was fighting a tree stump. And I won.
DIALOGUE_LR_2_LYLA_2: Of course you did. But try to do it with more 'finesse'. Flick the wrist! Strike a pose! Monsters hate those with bad posture.
DIALOGUE11_LYLA_1: Lyla, do you think this backpack matches my gear?
DIALOGUE11_LYLA_2: It's functional, I admit. But a ribbon bow would do wonders for your look.
DIALOGUE10_LYLA_1: Did you see the new seeds Lupi planted?
DIALOGUE10_LYLA_2: Yes! If they bloom in that shade of purple, I’ll need a new dress.
DIALOGUE1_MARCUS_1: How do you and Selene split tasks at the bar?
DIALOGUE1_MARCUS_2: She gives the orders, and I pretend I do too. Works just fine.
DIALOGUE2_MARCUS_1: Are the bar chairs comfier now, or is it just me?
DIALOGUE2_MARCUS_2: Swapped the cushions. Small luxuries matter.
DIALOGUE3_MARCUS_1: Doesn't it get boring serving the same folks every day?
DIALOGUE3_MARCUS_2: Not when each one tells the same story... just slightly worse each time.
DIALOGUE4_MARCUS_1: What would you do if the bar caught fire?
DIALOGUE4_MARCUS_2: I'd step out, call Selene, and let her handle it. She's scarier than fire.
DIALOGUE5_MARCUS_1: You're always so calm, Marcus. Even during slime attacks.
DIALOGUE5_MARCUS_2: Staying calm saves glassware. Panic spills drinks.
DIALOGUE7_MARCUS_1: Do you remember the name of that customer who only speaks in rhymes?
DIALOGUE7_MARCUS_2: Unfortunately, yes. He’s back every day... I think it starts with Jad... not completely sure.
DIALOGUE8_MARCUS_2: Forest fruits with a touch of honey. It smells like the village in spring.
DIALOGUE9_MARCUS_1: Marcus, the smell of cookies is taking over the village!
DIALOGUE9_MARCUS_2: That’s the secret to keeping everyone smiling, Rayy. A bit of sugar and memory.
DIALOGUE1_MAX_2: Of course! Just yesterday I defeated an invisible army.
DIALOGUE2_MAX_1: They say you used to be unbeatable!
DIALOGUE2_MAX_2: Used to be? Ha! I'm still undefeated—especially when no one's watching.
DIALOGUE3_MAX_1: You should take a break sometimes.
DIALOGUE3_MAX_2: Legends don't rest. We strike dramatic poses and deliver monologues.
DIALOGUE4_MAX_1: Did you really fight a five-headed beast?
DIALOGUE4_MAX_2: Whether it had two or five heads—no one knows. But I emerged victorious.
DIALOGUE5_MAX_2: Every morning. Until I remember I can sip tea while sitting down.
DIALOGUE6_MAX_2: I trained my intense, threatening stare. Works wonders on pigeons.
DIALOGUE_MR_3_RAYY_1: Max, is it true you once fought a Slime the size of a house?
DIALOGUE_MR_3_MAX_1: The size of a house? (Laughs) No! It was the size of *two* houses! And it had red eyes!
DIALOGUE1_Milo_1: The trees near the lake look taller, don’t they?
DIALOGUE1_Milo_2: They grew up. And they also learned to swing more slowly.
DIALOGUE2_Milo_1: How do you manage to stay so quiet all the time?
DIALOGUE2_Milo_2: I’m quiet because Lupi talks enough for both of us.
DIALOGUE3_Milo_1: Lupi said you’re fun, even when you’re quiet.
DIALOGUE3_Milo_2: He speaks for both of us. I just nod and smile.
DIALOGUE4_Milo_1: How long were you standing there today?
DIALOGUE4_Milo_2: Long enough to watch the world move around me.
DIALOGUE6_Milo_1: Did you see anything strange today?
DIALOGUE6_Milo_2: The wind whispered... there’s something odd in the air.Or maybe I’m just hungry.
DIALOGUE_MLR_1_RAYY_1: So... Milo. Lots of... feathers... today?
DIALOGUE_MLR_1_MILO_1: (He stares at you and blinks twice.)
DIALOGUE_MLR_1_RAYY_2: I'm going to interpret that as 'yes, and it's boring'.
DIALOGUE_MLR_2_RAYY_1: Any news today, Milo? Seen anything strange?
DIALOGUE_MLR_2_MILO_1: (He looks at the sky. Looks at Rayy. And lets out a small 'Crrk'.)
DIALOGUE_MLR_2_RAYY_2: 'The sky is blue' or 'A meteor is about to fall'? You're terrible at giving hints.
DIALOGUE1_SELENE_1: People really open up to you.
DIALOGUE1_SELENE_2: When you offer warmth instead of answers, they usually do.
DIALOGUE2_SELENE_2: For now. This village always hides surprises after sunset.
DIALOGUE3_SELENE_1: I need a tea that helps me think better.
DIALOGUE3_SELENE_2: I can make one. But the secret is drinking it slowly.
DIALOGUE4_SELENE_1: Do you think Max will ever move past his obsession with battles?
DIALOGUE4_SELENE_2: Maybe. Some scars only heal with time... and compassion.
DIALOGUE5_SELENE_1: That new tea made me see stars. Literally.
DIALOGUE5_SELENE_2: That means it’s working. Or... you just really need some sleep.
DIALOGUE6_SELENE_1: Have you ever thought about writing a book about the village?
DIALOGUE6_SELENE_2: Every day. But it’s hard to finish a chapter when Marcus keeps changing the ending.
DIALOGUE7_SELENE_2: The first dose is free. After that... it depends on the topic.
DIALOGUE8_SELENE_1: You always seem to know when someone needs to talk.
DIALOGUE8_SELENE_2: Eyes listen better than ears, Rayy. Most people forget that.
DIALOGUE9_SELENE_1: You used to be an adventurer, didn’t you?
DIALOGUE9_SELENE_2: A long time ago. Now, I prepare stories instead of living them.But both... can be healing.
DIALOGUE_SR_3_RAYY_1: Selene, what is in that purple drink of yours? The one that glows.
DIALOGUE_SR_3_SELENE_1: Oh, it has grape juice, sparkling water, and... a pinch of Ghost dust.
DIALOGUE_SR_3_RAYY_2: ...I think I’ll stick to a regular juice.
DIALOGUE10_SELENE_1: Selene, the plants seem brighter today.
DIALOGUE10_SELENE_2: They feel your energy, Rayy. They’re simply returning the affection.
DIALOGUE11_SELENE_1: Any new herbs for my adventure potions?
DIALOGUE11_SELENE_2: Try mixing blue petals with morning dew. Mental clarity will be immediate.
DIALOGUE1_VICTOR_2: Every page is a portal—if you know which one to open.
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_1: I heard you have some strange machines hidden at home.
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_2: Strange? No. Advanced. And not hidden—just... not ready for the public.
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_3: So it’s true? You’ve been testing some crazy invention on your own?
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_4: Let’s say I’m assessing features. And keeping side effects to a minimum.
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_5: 'Features'? Victor, one of the cows started dancing after touching one of those things.
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_6: That was... unexpected. But technically, a success. The cow seemed happy.
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_7: Are you really going to use that in the village?
DIALOGUE2_VICTOR_8: If it passes final testing. The village deserves innovation—even if it comes with music and dancing livestock.
DIALOGUE3_VICTOR_1: You always seem to know more than you say.
DIALOGUE3_VICTOR_2: Secrets build worlds... and they’re excellent for hiding cookies too.
DIALOGUE4_VICTOR_1: What’s your favorite part of the village?
DIALOGUE4_VICTOR_2: Where light meets shadow, and secrets whisper to those who know how to listen.
DIALOGUE5_VICTOR_1: Rayy... do you believe in things science can’t explain?
DIALOGUE5_VICTOR_3: Like what I saw in the forest last night... it floated and whispered my name.
DIALOGUE6_VICTOR_1: Have you walked through the south side of the village today?
DIALOGUE6_VICTOR_2: Yes. Two new trees, a fallen fence, and a cat napping on a book. Just another day.
DIALOGUE7_VICTOR_1: Have you ever tried taking a day off... from reading?
DIALOGUE7_VICTOR_2: I have. I started by reading how to do it.
DIALOGUE8_VICTOR_1: Do you ever leave this place?
DIALOGUE8_VICTOR_2: Occasionally. The trees have stories more valuable than most conversations.
DIALOGUE9_VICTOR_1: Do you have books about dancing monsters?
DIALOGUE9_VICTOR_2: After the last experiment... it might be time to write one.
DIALOGUE_VR_1_VICTOR_1: Miss Rayy. You ran 14% faster today than yesterday. Any particular reason?
DIALOGUE_VR_1_RAYY_1: A giant bat was trying to bite my head.
DIALOGUE_VR_1_VICTOR_2: Interesting. Adrenaline as a performance catalyst. Noted.
DIALOGUE_VR_2_RAYY_1: Victor, do you have any books that teach how to fight better? With diagrams?
DIALOGUE_VR_2_VICTOR_1: I have 'The Art of War' and 'Meditations on the Impermanence of Combat'. Neither has pictures.
DIALOGUE_VR_2_RAYY_2: ...I'll just keep hitting things with the pointy part of the sword.
DIALOGUE_VR_3_RAYY_1: Victor, you who knows everything, what’s the weakness of zombies?
DIALOGUE_VR_3_VICTOR_1: Academically? Their lack of cognitive agility and structural decomposition. And fire. Fire is statistically very effective.
DIALOGUE_VR_3_RAYY_2: ...I'll stick with 'hitting the head'. But thanks for the fire tip.
DIALOGUE_VR_4_VICTOR_1: 'Wrecked' is a colloquial and imprecise verb. Did you mean 'defeated', 'vanquished', or 'dismembered'?_
DIALOGUE10_VICTOR_1: Mayor, the village seems quite calm today.
DIALOGUE10_VICTOR_2: Calm is a sign that the rules are being followed. Keep it that way.
DIALOGUE11_VICTOR_1: Any important new decrees for Bloomrise?
DIALOGUE11_VICTOR_2: Just a small adjustment to seed taxes. Nothing that will change your routine.
DIALOGUE12_VICTOR_1: Mayor, the flowers in the square look immaculate.
DIALOGUE12_VICTOR_2: Maintaining aesthetic order is the first step toward a prosperous village.
DIALOGUE13_VICTOR_1: Any issues with my exploration journal, Victor?
DIALOGUE13_VICTOR_2: Only the margins, Rayy. Keep the text centered on the page.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON1_1: Rayy! Take this. It is the Bubbling Dragon Essence. Your enemies will be confused by the sound your insides will make after the first sip.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON1_2: This... this is just a soda, Max. It's kinda hot.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON1_3: Silence! Heat is the fire of victory. Drink and feel the gas of courage!
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON2_1: Be careful when handling this Edible Corn Shield. It is crunchy, lethal and contains the spice of fury.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON2_2: It looks like a well-stuffed taco. What did you do?
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON2_3: Legends don't cook, Rayy. They assemble layers of glory... and lettuce.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON3_1: I fished these Silent Sea Creatures with my own hands from an invisible river!
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON3_2: They are cut in a very professional way for anyone who has fought with invisible fish.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON3_3: The cutting technique is an ancient secret. Eat quickly before they regain their honor and try to escape.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON4_1: Accept this Butterstone Disc. It contains nuggets of black gold that restore the spirit of any barbarian.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON4_2: They're chocolate chips, Max. But thanks, I needed sugar.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON4_3: Sugar? This is crystallized adrenaline! Don't tell the pigeons, they would try to steal my treasure.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON5_1: Here, the Potion of Eternal Awakening. I once knocked over a giant just because I couldn't stop shaking after drinking this.
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON5_2: Wow, it's strong. How much powder did you put in this?
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON5_3: Enough to see the future. And in the future, Rayy... you owe me a favor.”
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON6_1: Get these White Corn Grenades. They exploded under the heat of my combat aura!
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON6_2: Or in the microwave in the village, right?
DIALOGUE_MAX_DUNGEON6_3: Technical details! They are light so as not to delay your escape... that is, your tactical assault!
TOWER_ENTER_1: Wow... It doesn't even look like the same dilapidated place as before. The potions benches, the staff holders... Everything was perfect!
TOWER_ENTER_2: They say every wizard needs a tower to call their own. I think now I finally have mine.
TOWER_ENTER_4: Hmm? What was that noise in the corner of the room?
TOWER_ENTER_5: Wait a minute... There's an old book lying here. And there are... glowing wings flapping beneath him?!
TOWER_ENTER_6: Calm down, let me lift this heavy tome... Ready!
TOWER_ENTER_7: Oh! A little fairy! Were you trapped down there this whole time?
TOWER_ENTER_9: Apparently you don't talk, right? But he loved the new tower! I'm glad I got you out of there.
TOWER_ENTER_11: Hey! Do you want to come with me? I think I just got a little magical assistant!
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_1: ...and if I turn this crystal to the north... Oh! A falling visitor? How poetic!
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_2: My head is spinning... That portal threw me to the ground and... why is the grass the color of beetroot?
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_3: Don't move! The microparticles of cosmic dust on your boots are dancing in perfect symmetry. Beautiful!
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_4: You are ignoring the fact that the floor is purple. Did I die? Is this the afterlife?
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_5: Almost! You are in Arcania! Where the impossible is just heating and the laws of physics take a vacation.
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_6: It is also the temporary home of three ducks that used to be my brooms. If they bite you, let me know.
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_7: I'm Mabel Moonbrook, star weaver, elixir refiner and... well, chaos enthusiast! And you, dusty creature?
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_9: Rayy from Bloomrise! Destiny really is a magical and crooked line. I was just looking for a guinea pig... I mean, a friend to test a potion that explodes in a super cute way!
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_10: Explode in a cute way?! I just wanted to know how to get home...
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_11: Ah, the portal is right there! But he's a little shaky right now... you know, Mondays.
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_12: While the transdimensional flow stabilizes, how about you pick some of those bright blue cherries for me?
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_13: Bright flowers? What do they do?
MABEL_FIRST_MEET_14: I have no idea! That's why it's going to be fun to find out. Come on, watch out for the ducks!
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_1_1: Mabel, I have the impression that this purple tree has moved since yesterday.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_1_2: Oh, they do that sometimes! Arcania's flora loves to go for a walk when no one is looking.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_1_4: Only when they're bored. It's a charming place, don't you think? How poetic!
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_2_1: Is everything okay here, Mabel? You've been staring into space for a while now.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_2_2: I'm trying to guess the color of the wind today. Sometimes it tastes like mint, you know?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_2_3: I don't think the wind tastes like anything in Bloomrise.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_2_4: A shame! You are missing the best part of aerodynamics.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_3_1: What are you studying in this giant book?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_3_2: Complex theories about the folding of the fabric of reality and the merging of stardust!
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_3_3: Wow... it seems really hard to understand.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_3_4: Ah, it's super simple, it's like making a cake, but if you get the recipe wrong, the cake will become dented. Nonsense!
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_4_1: Those ducks in the corner are looking at me kind of strangely...
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_4_2: Don't worry, they're just jealous because you wear boots and they have fins.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_4_3: Are you sure they won't bite me?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_4_4: Almost certain! If they start making noise like a broom sweeping, then you run.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GIFT_1: Hi, Mabel. What are you up to?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GIFT_2: Rayy! Perfect! Hold this here real quick for me, please?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GIFT_3: Um, sure... Wait, what is that? It's shining.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GIFT_4: A potion that I haven't tested, and I don't know if it will work. I was going to throw it away because I thought it was too bright for my lab, but it suits you. You can stay!
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_7_1: What's that pink smoke coming out of your cauldron?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_7_2: It's a volatile particle molecular heat inversion spell!
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_7_3: And... what exactly does this do in practice?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_7_4: It makes the soap bubbles fall upwards instead of downwards. Isn't it the cutest thing in the world?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_8_1: The Arcania wind is blowing strong today. Your hat won't fly off?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_8_2: Impossible! I enchanted the tip of it with a slight reverse gravitational force.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_8_3: So it's magnetically attached to your head?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_8_4: Basically! The only problem is that if I go near a metal spoon, I get stuck to it.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_9_1: Have you ever tried planting some normal Bloomrise stuff in this purple grass?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_9_2: I tried to grow some lettuce last month! The poor thing grew wings and flew towards the clouds.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_9_3: A flying lettuce? You're kidding me.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_9_4: I never play with arcane botany, Rayy! I just hope she found a nice flock of seagulls to migrate to.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_10_1: Mabel, aren't you bothered by that constant buzzing sound that floating crystals make?
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_10_2: Tinnitus? Why, Rayy, they're singing! It's an ancient melody about cosmic dust.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_10_3: To me it just sounds like a bunch of static electricity.
MABEL_ROUTINE_GENERIC_10_4: You just need to tune your ears to the right frequency. Or shake your head to the left three times! It helps a lot.

BERRY_INITIAL_ONPROGRESS_1: Hey Rayy! Did you manage to collect the Sapphire Cherries? I'm excited to see what happens when I mix them into my potion!
BERRY_INITIAL_ONPROGRESS_2: Not yet... I'm exploring Arcania. But I'll be back with the cherries soon!
BERRY_INITIAL_COMPLETED_1: I got your cherries, Mabel! They have a very nice smell
BERRY_INITIAL_COMPLETED_2: Wow, Rayy! These cherries are incredible!

QUEST_SNAKE_VENOM_DESC: Mabel needs snake venom to test a potion. She swears it's not dangerous, which means it probably is.
QUEST1_START_MABEL_1: Rayy! Snakes have such a... vibrant toxin! She makes an incredible *psss-pop* when she comes into contact with the cauldron!
QUEST1_START_MABEL_2: Could you collect three vials of poison for me? I promise to handle it with full responsibility. Or almost completely!
QUEST1_PROGRESS_MABEL_1: Still without the poison? It's okay, snakes aren't going anywhere... I guess. Just don't go near their teeth!
QUEST1_PROGRESS_MABEL_2: I'm working on it, Mabel. Trying to keep my hands in one piece!
QUEST1_END_MABEL_1: Oh! The poison! See how it glows in such a nice green tone!
QUEST1_END_MABEL_2: Be careful with that, Mabel! A drop of this can be fatal!

QUEST4_START_MABEL_2: Wow, Mabel! This looks amazing! But... you seem to want to mix something that doesn't seem very safe...

QUEST4_END_MABEL_2: Wow! The cauldron glowed an incredible golden green! It worked out?!
QUEST4_END_MABEL_3: It worked! Just look at this elixir! It's the most powerful potion I've ever made in my life! Keep it!
QUEST4_END_MABEL_4: This potion pulses with so much energy... It was worth every rat's tail! Thank you, Mabel!

QUEST4_ONCOMPLETE_MABEL_1: That great experiment has already been completed! I don't want to risk creating another elixir that powerful just yet.
QUEST4_ONCOMPLETE_MABEL_2: Understood! I think one legendary potion like this a day is more than enough.
